title.zh: v1.2.1 — 升级可靠性 · 模型目录可读性
title.en: v1.2.1 — install reliability, readable model catalog

items.zh: 对外模型 = 路由名 ∪ 账号目录模型：/v1/models 并集，直连模型不再误判 403
items.en: Public models = routes ∪ account catalogs; direct models no longer rejected with 403

items.zh: 插件升级不再因反代断流留下「半升级」：安装阶段与连接解绑 + 版本快照立即回写
items.en: Plugin upgrades survive proxy disconnects: install detached from the request context

items.zh: 账号详情模型目录显示上游模型名（Auto / GLM-5.3 / Kimi-K3 …），内部 key 作次要信息
items.en: Account detail shows upstream model names, internal keys as secondary text

items.zh: 离线插件清单同步 qoder 0.1.7 / qoderwork 0.1.8（上游信封 statusCode 字符串导致的空流）
items.en: Offline catalog synced to qoder 0.1.7 / qoderwork 0.1.8 (empty-stream fix)
